abstract_evidence_excerpt: Hydroxyl radicals (•OH) play a critical role in driving contaminants attenuation and elements cycling (e.g., nitrogen cycling) during redox fluctuations of paddy soil. Here, we found that amendments, mainly containing CaO and organic matter, significantly affected •OH formation and CH4 emissions in paddy soil.
